messages:
sam: hey team 👋 starting as a contractor today — small onboarding snag. I haven’t received a loaner laptop yet. Can I complete the mandatory security training and the phishsim on my personal Mac in the meantime? Also need VPN access for a dev environment — what’s the policy on split-tunnel / personal-device access? thanks!

maria: welcome, sam! :wave: short answers — you can do the training on a personal device, but we prefer company-managed devices for anything that touches prod or customer data. phishsim participation is mandatory (we can move your cohort window if needed). For VPN: contractors typically need either a company laptop enrolled in MDM or we provision a limited-scope devbox/cloud VM and give VPN/bastion access to that.

sam: thanks — re: phishsim window, I’m worried about failing it while I’m still getting set up. Can the deadline be moved a week?

maria: we can extend the deadline one week for onboarding exceptions — please confirm your manager approves. To request a loaner or an exception, file a ticket at https://intra.redwood/support with subject: "Loaner/Onboard Exception — sam" and paste your manager's approval. Include which repos/envs you need. Example snippet to paste in the ticket:
```
Manager: @lisa (approved)
Request: loaner laptop OR cloud devbox + VPN to access staging (no prod secrets)
Window: 1 week extension for phishsim/training
```

tonY: tagging from security — @maria we should ensure the devbox has endpoint monitoring and that credentials are ephemeral. If they must use a personal Mac before the loaner, require temporary SAML SSO + conditional access (block download access to buckets, no KMS key usage). For phishsim: don’t exempt — but we can delay enrollment window and give a 'learning' notification if they fail during onboarding.

infra: noted — we can stand up a small cloud devbox (ubuntu) with limited network egress and monitoring. If manager confirmation is attached we can provision within ~2 hours. I’ll need the env list and whether they need Docker / GPU.

devx-bot: Ticket created: #INC-49821 — "Loaner/Onboard Exception — sam". Status: triage. Assignee: infra. ETA provisioning: 2h (once manager approval is added).

sam: perfect — i’ll ping my manager now and paste the approval in the ticket. quick Q: for 2FA, can i use my personal phone for Okta verify or do i need a YubiKey?

maria: personal phone ok temporarily for Okta Verify, but contractors who will be long-term should request a YubiKey (people-ops will order after manager confirms). Make sure to enroll within 48 hours of getting access.

sam: awesome, thanks everyone. I’ve added @lisa approval in the ticket and marked the phishsim window request.

infra: got the approval, provisioning devbox now — will DM connection details and a short runbook (ssh + jump host).

maria: closing loop: phishsim window extended one week per manager approval. Please complete training ASAP and enroll 2FA. If anything blocks, reply here and we’ll escalate. :lock: :thumbsup:
